{{Otheruses|Needler}}
The '''needler-barb''' was the weapon created by the [[Jodakan needler crab]] to take down its prey. Created from a paralytic poison secreted into a dart, it was expelled from a hollow tube on the crab's back via the contraction of air sacs.
